hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qEi "(^|[&|;(])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*\b(main|master|production)([[:space:];|&)]|$)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master/production. Use a feature branch and PR." >&2; exit 2; fi'
